title: Emotional Intelligence
overview: The primary goal of this course is to equip participants with the skills necessary to enhance their Emotional Intelligence (EI). Through interactive sessions, attendees will delve into the significance of EI and its constructive influence on both professional and social aspects, intending to enhance the quality of their relationships in both work and personal life. Additionally, participants will gain insights into applying EI skills within the framework of the Mayer, Salovey, Caruso Emotional Intelligence Test (MSCEIT) model, facilitating the creation of a Personal Development Plan (PDP) aimed at advancing proficiency in all essential EI competencies.
audience: Managers, business professionals, and individuals who are committed to acquiring and refining their emotional intelligence skills with the goal of improving and effectively managing their relationships both in the workplace and in personal life
methodology: This course utilizes psychometrics to assist participants in recognizing their emotional intelligence capabilities. Additionally, the program incorporates interactive exercises and activities, enabling participants to formulate strategies that contribute to the enhancement of their emotional intelligence competencies
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explore the influence of emotions on human behavior
Apply the six principles of emotional intelligence to strengthen interpersonal relationships,
Interpret EI scores for enhanced interaction,
Analyze EI strengths and weaknesses using the MSCEIT model,
Create a Personal Development Plan (PDP) for advancing emotional intelligence
Utilize EI skills to optimize personal influence in both professional and social contexts.
